meta.name: Puduu
meta.language: Editorial Calm — premium rebuild. Zero emoji, Lucide only.

typography.display: Fredoka (display ONLY: greetings, timer digits, hero title, wordmark)
typography.numbers: tabular-nums for all times and durations
rules: Fredoka never for body copy or buttons — bubbly font everywhere reads toy-like.
Centered screens (ritual, dial, mascot header, mood, CTA stacks) are truly centered: textAlign center + centered containers.
Time gutter is right-aligned tabular numerals — editorial, scannable.
No strikethrough for done state: muted title + green check tile + 'Done' meta.

components.timelineCard: white card, left time gutter (right-aligned), 4px rail, 44px tinted tile, dark title, slate detail. No full-color blocks.
components.hero: dark ink gradient card, eyebrow + Fredoka title + meta, progress track + white Start pill in one bottom row.
components.tabbar: minimal: no pill backgrounds. Active = primary icon+label + 20px indicator bar. Inactive = faint.
components.buttons: primary CTA full-width; secondary stacks BELOW as ghost, never side-by-side.

rules: Zero emoji in product UI. Lucide icons only, 2px stroke, one family.
White text only on saturated surfaces (primary, hero, rails are never text backgrounds).
Meta text minimum slate #4B5563 on light surfaces.
